controlled_shops: Eight uniform draws with replacement from sorted engine shops, seeded independently of farm RNG and installed only after each end-of-day reveal.
design: Baseline and each candidate run in both seats against each opponent. Each game uses a fresh worker process. Seed is the independent cluster; seats are paired replicates.
natural_shop_caveat: Natural shops are not guaranteed to match within seed because weed spawning and shop draws share engine RNG whose consumption can depend on both farms.
